project_type: Serverless journal application with AWS CDK infrastructure, Python Lambda handlers, and HTML/JS frontend
build_system: AWS CDK v2 (Python), pip for dependencies. Node.js required for CDK CLI. Use `source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh` before any node/npm/npx commands.
test_framework: pytest for unit tests of Lambda handler logic
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/multi-user-journal-app && source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd infra && pip install -r requirements.txt && npx cdk synth
verification_instructions: 1. Install CDK deps and run cdk synth to validate infrastructure. 2. Run pytest for Lambda handler unit tests. 3. Verify frontend HTML loads without errors.
setup_instructions: 1. source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm install -g aws-cdk. 2. cd infra && pip install -r requirements.txt. 3. pip install -r src/requirements.txt for Lambda deps.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11 default. Node v22 via nvm. Cannot actually deploy to AWS (no credentials), but can validate CDK synth and run unit tests.
contribution_requirements: From .kiro/specs: Must use AWS CDK for IaC, custom JWT auth (not Cognito), DynamoDB for storage, max 10 users enforced, bcrypt for passwords, ULID for entry IDs.
key_patterns: Design specifies: 3 Lambda functions (auth_handler, entries_handler, search_handler), 2 DynamoDB tables (users, journal_entries), SSM Parameter Store for JWT secret, API Gateway HTTP API with CORS.
directory_structure: infra/ - CDK infrastructure code. src/handlers/ - Lambda function code. src/utils/ - shared utilities. frontend/ - static HTML/JS frontend. tests/ - pytest unit tests.
